name: Alternative Horsemanship™ the Remote Horse Coach

reasons.text: 视频标题提到“Equine Rehabilitation and Horse Re-education what is involved?”，简介描述“Remote Horse Coach”探讨心理、身体与情绪康复，涉及马匹康复与马术训练交叉方向。

cautions: 频道自称“Remote Horse Coach”，其是否具备马匹治疗专业资质未知。
